senses.gloss: to cut off, to guard; v. גִּיזְרָה a. גְּזֵרָה;—trnsf. to institute a precautionary measure (גְּזֵרָה); to enact a prohibition, to decree (mostly in a restrictive sense).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 1:4">Sabb. I, 4</cite> <he>ושמנה … גָּזְרוּ בו ביום</he> they issued eighteen enactments on that day.
<cite ref="Shabbat 14b:7">Ib. 14ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ טומאה על וכ׳</he> declared metal vessels (of gentiles) unclean (even when broken and remolten, v.

<cite ref="Shabbat 16b:9">ib. 16ᵇ</cite>). Ib. 17ᵇ <he>גזרו על פתן משום וכ׳</he> they prohibited their (the gentiles’) bread in order to prevent the use of their oil &c. Ib. 30ᵃ <he>מלך בו״ד גּוֹזֵר גזירה</he> a mortal king issues a decree.

<cite ref="Berakhot 61b:6">Ber. 61ᵇ</cite> <he>גָּזְרָה מלכות הרשעה שמד על ישראל שלא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) the wicked (Roman) government decreed religious persecution over Israel, that they should not study the Law &c.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:12">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>גזרו תענית</he> they ordered a public fast.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 2:9">Ib. II, 9</cite> <he>גּוֹזְרַנִי עליך וכ׳</he> I order thee to come to me &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 67b:4">Yoma 67ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>גזרה</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 16:22">Lev. XVI, 22</cite>) <he>אני ה׳ גְּזַרְתִּיו וכ׳</he> I, the Lord, have ordained it; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 17b:15">R. Hash. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>נִגְזְרָה גזירה</he> it has been decreed.

senses.gloss: to be cut to pieces. Yoma l. c. (ref. to גזרה, Lev. l. c.) דבר המִתְגַּזֵּר where an object thrown down is shattered to pieces. [
to be cut off, be steep. Ib. Ms. 2 מקום המתג׳ a steep place.]
